explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：先建目录，再 git init 生成 .git 仓库，git status 查看当前分支与文件状态。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): create a directory, git init to create the .git repository, then git status shows branch and file states.

examples.code:
mkdir my-project
cd my-project
git init
git status

note.zh-CN: git init 在当前目录创建仓库
note.en: git init creates a repository in the current directory

note.zh-CN: git status 查看状态

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：git add 把 notes.txt 放进暂存区，git commit -m 把暂存内容保存为一次提交。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): git add stages notes.txt and git commit -m saves the staged content as a commit.

examples.code:
git status
git add notes.txt
git commit -m "Add notes"

note.zh-CN: git add 把改动放进暂存区
note.en: git add moves the change into the staging area

note.zh-CN: commit 只保存已暂存的内容

title.zh-CN: 好的提交信息与不好的提交信息

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读：好的提交信息说清改动内容和意图；update code 这类信息无法帮助别人理解历史。
explanation.en: Read-only: a good message states what changed and why; messages like "update code" do not help anyone read history.

examples.code:
好的提交信息：
fix: reject empty note titles

不好的提交信息：
update code

note.zh-CN: 说明这是提交信息格式
note.en: This line introduces the message format

note.zh-CN: type 前缀表示改动类别
note.en: The type prefix categorizes the change

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：git log --oneline 用单行查看提交历史；git diff HEAD~1 HEAD 对比上上次与最近一次提交。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): git log --oneline lists commits one per line; git diff HEAD~1 HEAD compares the last two commits.

examples.code:
git log --oneline
git diff HEAD~1 HEAD

note.zh-CN: git log 查看提交历史
diff 对比两个快照

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：git branch 创建分支但不切换；git switch 才是切换分支的推荐命令。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): git branch creates without switching; git switch is the recommended way to switch.

examples.code:
git branch feature-login
git switch feature-login
git branch

note.zh-CN: branch 子命令用于分支操作
switch 切换当前分支

title.zh-CN: 把功能分支合并进 main
title.en: Merging a feature branch into main

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：在主分支上执行 merge；历史用 --graph 查看，快进合并不会产生新的合并提交。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): run merge while on main; inspect with --graph — a fast-forward creates no merge commit.

examples.code:
git switch main
git merge feature-login
git log --oneline --graph

note.zh-CN: merge 把另一分支并入当前分支
note.en: merge brings another branch into the current one

note.zh-CN: --graph 可视化历史形状

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读：<<<<<<< 到 ======= 是当前分支（HEAD）的内容，======= 到 >>>>>>> 是另一分支的内容，需要人工决定保留哪个版本。
explanation.en: Read-only: <<<<<<< to ======= is the current branch (HEAD) version and ======= to >>>>>>> is the other branch's; a human decides what to keep.

note.zh-CN: 当前分支内容从这里开始
分隔两个版本的等号线

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：编辑文件保留想要的内容并删除冲突标记，git add 标记为已解决，最后 git commit 完成合并。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): edit the file to the desired content, delete the markers, git add to mark resolved, then git commit to finish the merge.

examples.code:
# 1. 编辑文件，保留想要的内容并删除冲突标记
git add notes.md
# 2. 继续合并
git commit

note.zh-CN: git add 把文件标记为已解决
note.en: git add marks the file resolved

note.zh-CN: commit 完成这次合并

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：remote add 登记远程地址并命名为 origin；push -u 首次推送并建立跟踪关系。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): remote add registers the URL as origin; push -u uploads and sets up tracking.

examples.code:
git remote add origin git@example.com:ada/notes.git
git push -u origin main

note.zh-CN: remote 子命令管理远程仓库
push 上传本地提交

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：fetch 只下载不合并；pull 等于 fetch 后再合并当前分支，--ff-only 要求只能快进。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): fetch downloads without merging; pull fetches then merges, and --ff-only requires a fast-forward.

note.zh-CN: fetch 只更新远端跟踪分支
pull 会同时合并

title.zh-CN: 本地撤销与已推送撤销

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：reset --soft 撤销提交但保留改动；revert 生成反向提交，适合已经共享的历史。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): reset --soft drops the commit but keeps changes; revert creates an inverse commit for shared history.

examples.code:
# 撤销最近一次提交但保留文件改动
git reset --soft HEAD~1
# 生成一个反向提交，历史保留
git revert HEAD

note.zh-CN: reset 移动当前分支指针
note.en: reset moves the current branch pointer

note.zh-CN: revert 用新提交抵消旧提交
note.en: revert cancels an old commit with a new one

title.zh-CN: 用 stash 收起未完成改动

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（静态检查）：stash 把未提交改动存到一边，工作区变干净；处理完其他事情后用 stash pop 恢复。
explanation.en: Read-only (statically checked): stash shelves uncommitted changes so the tree is clean; restore them later with stash pop.

examples.code:
git stash push -m "wip: notes"
git switch main
git stash pop

note.zh-CN: stash 临时保存改动
pop 恢复并删除该条 stash
note.en: pop restores and drops that stash entry

title.en: Four steps of a pull request

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读：提交功能分支并推送 → 在托管平台建 PR → 按评审意见修改 → 通过后合并到主分支。
explanation.en: Read-only: commit and push the feature branch, open a PR on the host, address review comments, then merge into the main branch.

examples.code:
1. 在功能分支上提交并推送
git push -u origin feature-login
2. 在托管平台创建 Pull Request
3. 请求评审，按评论修改
4. 评审通过后合并到 main

note.zh-CN: 编号步骤
PR 是评审入口
note.en: The PR is the review entry point

title.zh-CN: 功能分支工作流命令序列

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读：从 main 拉出功能分支、小步提交、推送、开 PR 评审、合并后切回 main 拉取最新代码。
explanation.en: Read-only: branch from main, commit in small steps, push, open a PR for review, then switch back to main and pull latest.

examples.code:
1. git switch -c feature-x
2. git add . && git commit -m "feat: x"
3. git push -u origin feature-x
4. open pull request and review
5. git switch main && git pull

note.zh-CN: 第一步从主分支创建功能分支
note.en: Step one creates the feature branch from main

note.zh-CN: 提交改动并附信息
